parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=6: val_bpb 0.943874 -> 0.914265. Increasing model capacity significantly improved performance. Next, I'll stack WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on top of this high-capacity model, following the regularization trends seen by agent-4 and agent-8.
